mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls over the past 3 months indicates strengthening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in the Consumer Price Index exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in non-farm payrolls signals a monetary tightening cycle that is suppressing labor market growth, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy enters a contraction phase.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and PAYEMS falls > 50k in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and PAYEMS falls > 50k over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts show three consecutive months of growth, it indicates a strengthening housing sector that typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the sector's expansion supports broader economic activity and corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where HOUST has risen for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tight labor market that typically leads to higher corporate profit margins and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy approaches full employment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE is below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and housing starts indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and potential recession.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5% and HOUST falls > 1.0% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 0.5% and HOUST falls > 1.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined by the Federal Reserve raising the federal funds rate for at least 3 consecutive meetings), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher interest rates dampen equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods during a monetary tightening cycle (as defined by 3 consecutive rate hikes).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity that typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as stronger growth supports corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of quarters where GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% year-over-year.
